title: Backhoe Jobs

serves.summary: The learner gives each job (dig, reach, scoop and carry, hold still, drive) to the backhoe part that does it, which shows they can name a machine part by its function.

request.topic: The parts of a backhoe and the job each part does
request.objective: Name the part of a backhoe that does each job: the rear digging bucket digs holes, the long arm (boom) reaches, the front loader bucket scoops and carries loose dirt, the legs (stabilizers) hold the machine still, the wheels drive it, the cab is where the driver sits and sees. (SCI005-04-d)

problems.ask: Give each job to the part of the backhoe that does it.
problems.goal: The dig card is on the rear digging bucket and the carry card is on the front loader bucket: the back bucket digs the hole, the front bucket scoops and carries loose dirt.

problems.ask: Give these four jobs to the parts that do them.
problems.goal: Dig is on the rear bucket, carry on the front bucket, hold still on the stabilizer legs and drive on the wheels: the legs press down to keep the machine from moving while it digs; the wheels move it.

problems.ask: Give all five jobs to the parts that do them.
problems.goal: Reach is on the long arm (boom) and dig is on the bucket at its end; carry is on the front bucket, hold still on the legs and drive on the wheels. The arm reaches out; only the bucket on its end digs.

problems.ask: Each picture shows what a job left behind. Give each one to the part that did it.
problems.goal: The hole is on the rear digging bucket, the full truck on the front loader bucket, the tyre tracks on the wheels and the round pad marks on the stabilizer legs: the child reads the job from its result, with no machine in the picture.
